question: Can GK02538 be assigned to the Daetongryokja / 觀象監大統曆字 subtype merely because its title is 大統曆註 and its catalog type is generic 觀象監活字?
answer: NO_TITLE_STRING_SUBTYPE_SHORTCUT; KASI_1997_MATCHING_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_ITEM_REMAINS_GENERIC_觀象監活字; SECONDARY_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_EVIDENCE_CITING_KIM_SANGHO_1987_P132_APPLIES_觀象監大統曆字_ACROSS_1651_1652_大統曆_AND_1653_1723_時憲曆; GK02538_OBJECT_SPECIFIC_SUBTYPE_REMAINS_UNRESOLVED
